name: Ni De Niuzi
source:
My life is ordinary, nothing is particularly good, nothing is particularly bad, just a simple and happy ordinary life.

I thought I would just live my college life like this, until that day...

"Oh my god, there is a cow!!"

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3764120/]Steam[/url]]
